notablePrerequisites: Mairsil does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Mairsil using Endling's third ability by paying {B}, giving Mairsil undying until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Vassal's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Mairsil dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Mairsil using Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
